 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 18 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Something may feel like a challenging beginning; you may have been excited about a fresh spark but feeling all over the place at the same time. Cancer , breathe. Ask your mind to stop going into overdrive and simply come back to your present moment. Notice how you may be feeling strapped not because you don't know where to begin, but simply because your mind has already reached the problems that may arrive at step 100 before you have even walked on step 1. Remind yourself that just like water, you function best when you flow. Trust your vision, take one step at a time and streamline your focus onto what matters most.
 Cosmic tip: Ask for an outsider’s valid perspective if you are feeling too bunched up in your own head. Then take clear guided steps forward.
